selection_reason: Logistic Regression (baseline) had the highest validation ROC-AUC (1.000; ties broken by PR-AUC then recall). Selection never used test data. Decision threshold: highest threshold keeping validation recall >= 90% (validation specificity at this threshold = 1.000); chosen for screening where missed cases are costlier than false alarms.
threshold_rule: highest threshold keeping validation recall >= 90% (validation specificity at this threshold = 1.000); chosen for screening where missed cases are costlier than false alarms

global_explanation.note: Mean |SHAP| over a sample of the held-out test set. Importance shows what the model relies on, not causal effect.

fairness.reason: Dataset has no recognised age/sex columns, so subgroup fairness cannot be audited.
limitations: Fairness metrics describe disparities on one held-out test set; small subgroups give wide, unstable estimates.
No single metric establishes fairness; demographic parity, equal opportunity and equalized odds can conflict.
Only attributes present in the data are audited (no ethnicity/socioeconomic data unless supplied); intersectional groups are not evaluated.
Calculating these metrics does not mean bias has been removed.

class_balance_method: class_weight / scale_pos_weight in training only (no resampling of validation/test)
calibration: Platt scaling fitted on the validation set
limitations: No age/sex columns present - subgroup fairness cannot be audited for this dataset.
Single-source public dataset: no external or prospective validation; not clinically validated.
Test set has only 114 records (42 positive); 95% CI for recall is 0.84-0.99. Treat metrics as indicative only.

error_costs.false_negative: A missed malignancy delays treatment - the most serious error.
error_costs.false_positive: A false alarm leads to additional imaging/biopsy.
